subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in
stimulus: the parentheses. 1×5=5 Illiteracy is a curse. No (a) ______ (develop) programme can attain success due to (b) ______ (illiterate). On the other hand (c) ______ (educate) is the backbone of a nation. It removes (d) ______ (ignorant) and (e) ______ (lighten) mind. It also shows how malnutrition, hunger and disease can be overcome.
guide_solution: Suffixes/Prefixes: (a) development (b) illiteracy (c) education (d) darkness (e) enlightens
